status_note: These are courses I am enrolled in. Enrollment is separate from course completion or professional certification.

courses.title: Unlock Excel VBA and Excel Macros
courses.purpose: Build more reliable Excel tools through reusable macros, clear interfaces, and deliberate error handling.
courses.practice: Extend a workbook automation with input validation, a useful error message, and a documented test case.

courses.title: The Complete dbt Bootcamp: Zero to Hero + Certification Prep
courses.purpose: Deepen the transformation layer: modular SQL models, data tests, lineage, and documentation that make analytics easier to trust.
courses.practice: Create a small source-to-mart dbt model with explicit grain, relationship tests, and documented business definitions.

courses.title: Apache Airflow: The Hands-On Guide
courses.purpose: Strengthen orchestration decisions around scheduling, dependencies, retries, backfills, and pipeline observability.
courses.practice: Document a retry and backfill scenario for an existing DAG, including what happens when an upstream source fails.

courses.title: Big Data Engineering Bootcamp with GCP, and Azure Cloud
courses.instructor: Krish Naik, Mayank Aggarwal & KRISHAI Technologies
courses.purpose: Connect distributed processing fundamentals with practical ingestion and storage choices across cloud data platforms.
courses.practice: Compare a local batch-processing lab with a proposed cloud architecture, including costs, failure modes, and data movement.

courses.title: Fundamentals of Operating Systems
courses.purpose: Understand the operating-system behavior beneath a slow query, a container, or a data-processing workload.
courses.practice: Extend a small process or memory experiment with observations, commands, and a reproducible explanation.

courses.title: A Practical guide to Docker containers - Arabic
courses.purpose: Make local data and automation environments easier to run, debug, and hand over to another person.
courses.practice: Review a Compose service for persistent storage, health checks, networking, and clear recovery instructions.

courses.title: Fundamentals of Database Engineering
courses.purpose: Connect data-modeling choices to the database engine: consistency, indexes, concurrency, and query execution.
courses.practice: Compare execution plans before and after an index change, recording the data size and measurement method.
